title: Research construction: direct-source E8 with 120 fewer helpers
body:
**Research construction: a smaller depth-one complex RAM supplier. No new integer-multiplication κ.**

This concrete variant of PR647 lets the actual source registers feed the E8 pair/gather core. Each source stays at its port frame until its last pair read, then grows to FULL for the gathers. This removes **120 live input-copy helpers and 720 global recursive children**, while preserving the full dirty-restored forward/backward interface.

The complete new profile is `m=27, W=7088, R=6848, H={1:40680,2:240,7:20160,8:1080,9:48}`, with deficit 24. It admits a Gaussian-RAM saving **η=1/14100**, with exact rank-mass slack above 11/100. A rational lower bound shows the predecessor's profile fails at that same value, so this is a construction improvement rather than a finer rounding claim. The predecessor's explicit certificate used 1/15000. Existing community suppliers remain stronger overall.

The proof includes source access, helper-only old-response evaluation, inverse-adjoint backward execution, cleanup, center copies in both directions, private workspace, phase adapters, the retained three-stage cover, ordinary padding inputs and the complete all-size RAM cost recurrence. Global scalar ADDs fall from 139456 to 116248. The source's exact complex RAM model is retained; bit precision, tapes, multiplication assembly and a new Fourier transfer are outside scope.

**Reproduce** (Python 3.9+, standard library; do not use `-O`):

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-direct-source/verify.py --check research/e8-direct-source/RESULTS.json
python3 -B research/e8-direct-source/test_verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_E8_DIRECT_SOURCE: 7088 columns in both directions; 120 fewer helpers; 7 negative controls`, then three tests `OK`.

Validation:
- Every one of 7088 independent live columns in both directions, every chronological frame, 3601 local phase projectors, and the final rank-two phase lowering.
- Exact full invoices and rational moments, seven negative controls, plus 48 separate modular physical executions with actual Gaussian phase/center transport.
- Receipt and tests pass locally on Python 3.9.6, 3.11.16 and 3.13.16. Optimized Python is explicitly rejected because inherited phase utilities use assertions.
- Source pins, staged immutable bytes, selected-record integrity, workflow syntax, whitespace and clean archive replay checked. [Scoped Linux CI](https://github.com/swbiggart/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38346036760) passed on Python 3.11 and 3.13 at submitted head `3219863d868b4230eeb4bf2948758eff45efffcf`, including the full receipt, three tests and clean-tree checks. This is separate from broader repository CI.
- No full repository-suite pass claimed. The previous full run stopped at missing Boost headers in the unchanged selected bit supplier; that expensive suite was not repeated for this isolated package.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`.
PR647: `956bb581e7f97328e1b53baa5aca3d2490f2f607`.
Assignment seed **26**, complex supplier; source port 26 supplies the adversarial read controls. No pinned coordination issue existed. The local claim has one result update. Overlap checked through #692 (512 open PRs); the predecessor head is unchanged. PR682 audits the old tensor profile and does not implement this rewrite.

Credits: Artus / @artuskg's PR647, its OpenAI Pro provider proof, Codex verification and all retained E8/community predecessors. The predecessor's phase/binary-arithmetic utilities and notice are vendored unchanged and authenticated; this reuse is explicit, not described as a wholly independent checker. Prepared by Scott Woolsey Biggart (@swbiggart) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0. No human-only review or formal proof is claimed. No existing file, upstream source or selected-frontier pointer changes.
